description: Implementation of the ClearMultiviewGL class for managing multiview framebuffer clearing operations in OpenGL, including resource management, attaching/detaching textures, and clearing buffers.

classes.name: ClearMultiviewGL
classes.description: A helper class for clearing multiview side-by-side and layered framebuffers in OpenGL.

methods.name: clearMultiviewFBO
methods.description: Clears a multiview framebuffer object if the first attachment is multiview.

methods.name: clearLayeredFBO
methods.description: Attaches textures for each view and clears the layered framebuffer.

methods.name: genericClear
methods.description: Performs the actual buffer clearing based on the clear command type.

methods.name: attachTextures
methods.description: Attaches textures to the framebuffer for each view layer.

methods.name: initializeResources
methods.description: Initializes framebuffer resources if not already created.
